{{Recipe summary
| Category = Chicken recipes
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
*2 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] [[Cookbook:Ricotta|ricotta cheese]]
*2 ounces [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] grated [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]], divided
*2 boneless skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken#Breast|chicken breast]]<nowiki/>s, cut in half
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
*Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
*1 cup [[Cookbook:Italian Tomato Sauce|Italian Tomato Sauce]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine ricotta, cream cheese, and ½ cup mozzarella cheese. Set aside.
#Place chicken on a sheet of [[Cookbook:Plastic Wrap|plastic wrap]] and cover with another. Pound out to ¼ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] thickness.
#Sprinkle one side of chicken liberally with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Spread unseasoned side with cheese mixture and roll up. 
#Place seam-side down in a greased 13x9-inch (or smaller) [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]]. Pour sauce over and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] in a 425°F oven 20 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
#Heat [[Cookbook:Broiler|broiler]]. Sprinkle chicken with cheese and place under broiler until cheese is melted. Remove and serve warm.
